title: Scorpio: what to know
description: The essentials of Scorpio in a few screens: strengths, challenges, love and work.

pages.title: Scorpio: the basics
pages.text: Approximate dates: Oct 23 - Nov 21. Water element, fixed quality, ruled by Pluto (and Mars in classical astrology).

pages.title: Depth
pages.text: Scorpio is focused, intense and goes to the bottom of things, never settling for the surface.

pages.title: Distrust
pages.text: Can hold grudges and test others. Trusting step by step avoids needless distance.

pages.title: All or nothing
pages.text: Gives themselves fully, but only after trusting. Expects total loyalty.

pages.title: The one who investigates
pages.text: Focused and resilient. Shines in research, strategy, analysis and high-pressure moments.
